title: Having Trouble Making Purchases with Your Card?
summary: This document explains why a Rho-Bank credit card purchase may be declined despite available credit and lists common causes: fraud protection flags, merchant entry/terminal issues, card not activated, expired card, international transaction restrictions, and temporary technical issues. It also provides first steps to retry, verify card details/CVV and expiration, confirm activation, and try a different terminal/merchant; then directs customers to contact support at 1-800-RHO-BANK, via the Rho-Bank mobile app chat, or rhobank.com/help.
